capabilities: search books by title, author, or ISBN
create book notes from a built-in or custom template
download and store book cover images in the vault
maintain a library overview note with a Dataview table
toggle read status on book notes
disambiguation: Not a note-organization or note-library manager; it catalogs books as notes fetched from online book databases.
extras: The library overview table requires the Dataview plugin, which the plugin does not install. Google Books search needs a free API key from Google Cloud; Open Library works without any account. The README includes a migration guide for users coming from the Book Search plugin and a privacy section describing its network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up books online and turn them into notes with metadata, covers, and a running overview of the collection.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Book Search by anpigon (MIT License). Library Notes follows its idea of book notes from templates
The library table uses Dataview by Michael Brenan.

summary: Book cataloger that searches Open Library (and optionally Google Books), creates a templated note per book with a saved cover, and maintains a Dataview library overview table.
